native_retrieval.title: Once an Agitator, Now in Charge of Delhi's Government - The New York Times
native_retrieval.snippet: ###### India Ink | Once an Agitator, Now in Charge of Delhi’s Government. # Once an Agitator, Now in Charge of Delhi’s Government. Arvind Kejriwal, leader of Aam Aadmi Party, after taking oath as the new chief minister of Delhi at the Ramlila grounds in New Delhi on Saturday. Arvind Kejriwal, leader of Aam Aadmi Party, after taking oath as the new chief minister of Delhi at the Ramlila grounds in New Delhi on Saturday.Credit Anindito Mukherjee/Reuters. NEW DELHI — On Saturday morning, Arvind Kejriwal, the leader of the Aam Aadmi Party, took the subway from his house in Ghaziabad, a suburb bordering Delhi, to Barakhamba Road in central Delhi. This was an unusual way to travel for someone about to be inaugurated as the city’s chief minister. The Ramlila Maidan, a large, sprawling ground in central Delhi was chosen as the site where Mr. Kejriwal would take oath as chief minister of Delhi.
